methodologyNotes: Covers 12-volt automotive starting (SLI) batteries sold at US retail for passenger cars, trucks, and SUVs. Excludes motorcycle/powersports batteries, marine or golf-cart deep-cycle-only units, and any non-12V pack. Price is typical US street/retail price in USD (most battery brands publish no formal MSRP), excluding any refundable core charge. batteryType is the construction/chemistry, one of: AGM, flooded (conventional wet lead-acid), EFB, spiral-wound-AGM, or lithium-ion (LiFePO4). bciGroupSize is the BCI/DIN group-size designation exactly as published (e.g. "34", "48/H6", "94R/H7") as a string. coldCrankingAmps (CCA) in amps, rated at 0 degrees F (-18 C) per SAE/BCI. crankingAmpsCa in amps at 32 degrees F (0 C); null if not published. reserveCapacityMin is reserve capacity in minutes (25 A draw at 80 F down to 10.5 V); null if not published. capacityAh is nominal capacity in amp-hours at the 20-hour rate; null if not published. terminalType is the terminal layout, one of: top-post, side-post, dual (SAE plus side/GM), or stud. weightLbs is battery weight in pounds. warrantyMonths is the free-replacement warranty period in months (pro-rated periods excluded). maintenanceFree is a boolean, true when the battery is sealed and needs no electrolyte top-up. dimensionsInches is overall size as length x width x height in inches.
